verdict.summary: The documentation-only change is consistent with the repository's upstream-contribution policy: AGENTS.md explicitly requires draft status, agent identification, a maintainer-review warning, a Why section, reviewer assignment with an @-mention fallback when assignment is unavailable, and forbids agents from marking an upstream PR ready. The lockfile also corroborates the repository-specific dependency statement (hdt 0.7.3 and qwt 0.4.0). No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is introduced by this diff.
